summary: AgroShift FieldSense is a climate-smart agricultural decision-support platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It uses NASA POWER Earth observation data to help farmers understand local climate conditions and make more informed crop-rotation decisions. The platform retrieves location-based climate information and presents it through an interactive dashboard with visual charts. It also includes a crop-rotation recommendation endpoint designed to support more resilient farming decisions. By connecting climate information with agricultural planning, AgroShift FieldSense aims to help farmers understand environmental conditions, explore crop-rotation options, and adapt their farming practices to changing climate patterns. The project focuses on making scientific climate data more accessible and useful for agricultural decision-making, particularly in communities where access to practical climate information can be limited.
details:
AgroShift FieldSense is a web-based agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make informed decisions using climate information and crop-rotation planning.

The platform integrates NASA POWER data to retrieve climate information for selected geographic locations. The data is processed through a Python FastAPI backend and presented in an interactive React dashboard using charts and visualisations. Users can explore climate conditions and use the platform's crop-rotation recommendation functionality to support agricultural planning.

The system was developed using React, Vite, JavaScript, CSS, Python, FastAPI, Supabase, Recharts and Leaflet. NASA POWER provides the climate data used by the platform.

The project addresses the challenge of making Earth observation data more accessible and practical for agriculture. Its intended impact is to support climate-aware farming decisions, encourage more resilient crop-rotation practices and demonstrate how open Earth science data can be transformed into useful tools for farmers.

The team considered the importance of location-specific climate information, accessibility, understandable visualisations and the practical needs of farmers. AgroShift FieldSense brings climate data and agricultural decision support together in one platform.
